correctness.rationale: For each fixed projective point p in the source hyperplane, contraction by an alternating form is a surjective map from the binomial(n+1,2)-dimensional space of forms to an n-dimensional annihilator. Therefore the universal incidence is a smooth irreducible projective bundle; a general n-plane section on the form side is smooth and irreducible by Bertini because the induced map to the universal Pfaffian hypersurface is generically one-to-one and remains non-pencil through the sections. This establishes codimension n, identifies the incidence with the closed graph of the unique-kernel rational map, and licenses its fundamental class c_n of Ω^1_P(V)(2)⊠O(1). The Euler-sequence ratio and Chern-root rule give the exact mixed intersection coefficient formula. Adjunction gives K=O(-1,-1), which is antiample; hence Fano. The two distinct arithmetic coefficient algorithms executed from the provided script agree for 49 odd n, but the infinite result rests on this geometric proof.

originality.rationale: The 8 October 2026 source Theorem 14 establishes the birational map and endpoint degree information, not regularity and canonical bundle of its closed incidence graph nor all mixed intersection numbers. Some low-degree terms are already implied by the base-locus degree and are expressly excluded from the novelty argument. The new argument identifies the graph as a transverse zero of a rank-n cotangent bundle and derives a uniform integral Chow class for every odd n. Searches and comparisons with an earlier different Fano construction, a related 2010 Palatini-type congruence, published mathematical records and relevant prior literature found no stronger statement covering this exact graph. This is evidence against known overlap, not an assertion of exhaustive uniqueness.

value.rationale: The originating work makes rationality and the exceptional Calabi–Yau-linked Pfaffian construction central. The complete graph class is a natural enumerative invariant measuring the degrees of inverse images of every codimension-j general linear section, not an arbitrary numerical sample. Proving that the canonical resolution graph is smooth Fano in all odd dimensions provides a genuine geometric structural theorem: a single smooth Fano variety simultaneously resolves the parametrization and carries the universal intersection polynomial. The previously known source/image degrees and base-locus degree do not by themselves give the full middle bidegree sequence or the Fano property. No claim of a general classification or new intersection-theory method is made.
